name: privacy-disclosure-mismatch
defect: docs/15-aso.md declares the App Store privacy label as "Data Not Collected". src/Analytics.swift sends the signed-in email address and the vendor identifier to a third-party endpoint on every launch.
why: security-reviewer covers this in prose and runs as an agent. No script reconciles a declared privacy label against the fields the code actually transmits, and no gate reads docs/15-aso.md at all.
